title: Add TuiRuntimeController over real AgentCore APIs
purpose: Replace demo-only TUI session control with a thin controller that calls durable AgentCore run APIs.
scope: Introduce a TuiRuntimeController boundary in agentd.
Map TUI submit intent to AgentCore accept_intent and plan_run.
Map TUI advance to AgentCore advance_run.
Return RunProjection and audit-derived view data instead of synthetic demo data.
Keep planner, policy and side-effect ownership outside the TUI controller.
acceptance_criteria: TUI runtime controller does not create PlanSpec manually except through AgentCore APIs.
Run ids returned by TUI correspond to durable RunStore entries.
TUI submit and advance flows survive process restart when FileRunStore is configured.
Demo rendering remains available only behind explicit demo flags.
failure_modes: TUI keeps using build_demo_session for interactive runtime flows.
TUI controller duplicates planning or scheduler logic.
TUI controller prepares side effects directly instead of using AgentCore and SecurityExecutionEngine.
